title: butia capitata subsp. yatay
intro: Butia capitata subsp. yatay, commonly known as Pindo Palm, is a species of palm tree native to South America. It is known for its edible fruit and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Butia capitata subsp. yatay include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve digestive health, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
